intro: Type a length and see it in every unit at once.

field.label: Length
field.hint: For example 89, 3 1/2" or 6' 4 1/4". Without a unit, numbers use your preferred Unit System.

precision.label: Imperial precision
precision.hint: Smallest fraction shown in the fractional-inch and feet-and-inches results.

errors.unreadable: That length can't be read. Try something like 89 mm, 3 1/2" or 6' 4 1/4".
